text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Grand Concert is a hit! Students and fans alike give their emotions free rein, creating unforgettable memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello watches from beside the stage with an affectionate and contented smile, her vision finally having come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Backstage, girls exchange high fives as they rush out into the welcoming arms of their fans.
